title: Prominent 14-word disclaimer with voice-over
description: In audio-visual creatives the standard 14-word warning must be prominent, with the visual and an accompanying voice-over reiteration audible and clear, running for at least 5 seconds.
source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (j); internal Video checkpoints

pass.content: Video with the 14-word warning on screen and a matching voice-over running for 6 seconds.

fail.content: Video where the disclaimer flashes for 1 second with no voice-over.

title: Regional-language and Hinglish disclaimer treatment
description: For a regional-language video the 14-word disclaimer must also be in the regional language; for Hinglish content the voice-over of the disclaimer must be in Hindi and the disclaimer text must appear in both Hindi and English.
source_clause: Internal Video checkpoints; Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (ia)

pass.content: Hinglish video with a Hindi voice-over of the disclaimer and on-screen text in both Hindi and English.

fail.content: Regional-language video whose disclaimer appears only in English.
fail.note: Disclaimer not in the regional language.

title: Approved script, legible labels, no conflicting graphics
description: The video content must match the approved script exactly, must carry legible product labels and risk-o-meter, and must not contain conflicting images or graphics.

pass.content: Video matches the approved script, shows legible product labels and risk-o-meter, and has no conflicting graphics.

fail.content: Video adds an off-script claim and shows a background graphic that contradicts the risk label.
